meta.name: self-customize
meta.description: Customize your own agent — add capabilities, install packages, add MCP servers, edit code or CLAUDE.md. Use when the user asks you to add a feature, install a tool, or modify how you work. For non-trivial code changes, delegate to a builder agent via create_agent.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自定义你的智能体，添加功能、安装包或修改配置
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要按需调整智能体的能力和行为
copy.tagline_en: Customize your agent by adding capabilities, packages, or modifying configs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to tailor your agent's abilities and behavior on demand

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能按你的要求修改自身：添加功能、安装软件包或 MCP 服务器、编辑代码或记忆文件。涉及改代码时，它会派一个专门的 builder 代理执行，改完向你汇报确认。
howto.when: 当你说“帮我加个功能”“安装某某工具”，或要求它改变工作方式时触发。若涉及修改源码，它会改用 builder 代理来处理。

say.text: 帮我在环境里装一个抓取 RSS 的 MCP 服务器
say.note: 它会先查现成的 MCP 服务器，再请求管理员批准。

say.text: 我需要转录语音，请安装 ffmpeg 和 transformers 包
say.note: 系统包安装需管理员批准，批准后自动重建镜像。

say.text: 把我的项目组织偏好写进长期记忆
say.note: 这是改记忆文件，无需批准。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can modify its own environment on request: add capabilities, install packages or MCP servers, edit code or memory files. For source-code changes it delegates to a dedicated builder agent and then reports back for review.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to add a feature, install a tool, or change how it works. Source-code edits are delegated to a builder agent.

say_en.text: Help me set up an MCP server that fetches RSS feeds.
say_en.note: It finds an existing server, then asks admin approval.

say_en.text: I need audio transcription, install ffmpeg and transformers.
say_en.note: System packages need admin approval; image rebuilds after.

say_en.text: Save my project preferences to long-term memory.
say_en.note: Edits memory files directly; no approval needed.
